comment: Honestly this is overdue. $10.99 for basically the entire recorded catalog is still a steal, and if even a bit more of it reaches artists I'm fine with it. I'd just like them to actually say where the extra money goes, because artists are the ones getting squeezed the most.

Cool, more money for the same playlist app that still can't show me liked songs inside a playlist or let me add a duplicate on mobile. I already left once over this crap, so if the next update doesn't fix it I'm out for real.

Spotify raises the price and STILL no lossless. Tidal has had HiFi for a lower price for ages, and that's already where my music listening goes. I'm keeping Spotify for Connect and the recs, but this is a bad look.

Good for them I guess. I already cancelled my family plan because the home screen is a podcast wall, so paying more for that is a hard no from me. You can't even permanently hide podcasts, only filter them, which is insane.

Eh, I mostly care whether the features I actually use are still there. If the price goes up and they keep removing stuff like manual album radio, that's the part that bugs me. Does anyone know if stats.fm is still working the same after the update?

Honestly the price bump is fine, still cheaper than Apple Music for the library I get. My real issue is Discover Weekly and song radio keep serving the same songs I already have. If they're raising prices, at least fix the recs.

A dollar more is not the end of the world. Premium still feels like a good bang for the buck with the catalog and the lifestyle stuff, and the free tier keeps getting more ads, so the gap is still worth it to me. Still think $10 to remove ads alone is a lot, though.

Does a price increase even matter if the renewal pop-up keeps showing up after I cancelled? Every time I open the app it's there. Reinstalled, cleared cache, nothing. Anyone have a fix that actually works?
Paying MORE for this?? The home screen is still TikTok garbage and I can't even get my recently played back. Bring back the old UI or I'm done, Apple Music is looking very nice right now.
Cool, pay more for an app that still hides my liked songs on albums and charges me to see play counts. I unsubscribed once already and won't hesitate to do it again if this doesn't get fixed.

Spotify is raising prices and still no lossless? Apple Music gives you lossless and Spatial Audio in the same plan for basically the same money. I'm only on Spotify for Chromecast and Android Auto, but this makes Apple Music look even better.
Student price going up a dollar, ugh. Still easy peasy with Hulu included though, $6 is still a great deal for what you get. If it jumps again I'll be looking at Apple Music again.
Price goes up for an app I'm only using because I avoid the new layout on an old version. Cool. If they force the new layout permanent I'm cancelling, and I already cancelled once over this UI.
Still beats paying for two services. $10.99 for no ads and offline downloads is fine by me, the free tier is basically unusable. I just wish they'd stop breaking the app with UI changes.

$11 for Premium and I still hear ads in podcasts? Spotify keeps shoving podcasts down my throat and the ads still play. Honestly I'd pay more for a setting that just kills podcasts and audiobooks. Pass on the podcast stuff.
Ugh, I can barely afford $10 some months and now it's $11? I'll probably drop back to free for a bit. Also still annoyed about the renewal prompts after I cancel lol.
Raising the price and still no lossless. Tidal has HiFi in its base tier and I'm already there for that. Spotify is making it pretty clear they don't care about people who actually want decent audio.
I'm on free so this changes nothing for me right now, but it makes rejoining Premium harder to justify. I'm still tempted for the no ads and being able to skip, I just don't love paying more for it.
Price up and features still missing or hidden behind tests? Stop charging more and start giving back the stuff you removed. I'm going to keep voting with my wallet until they do.

So I'm paying more for an app that gets worse with every redesign and keeps shoving podcasts at me? The recs are the only thing keeping me here and YouTube Music is right there. I'll stick around for now but this is not helping.

More money for shuffle that still plays the same 20 songs out of my 200 song playlist? Lol. Every time they add another tap to get to shuffle I think about Apple Music. Staying for the app and CarPlay for now.
Great, price up for an app that still breaks after every update. Downloaded songs not playing offline has been broken for me forever and support is useless. I'm not expecting much from this.

Duo going to $14.99 is still fine for us. That's about $7.50 each, ad free, with separate accounts, and nothing else I've looked at beats it. Mostly I'm just annoyed about the email people are going to get.
Paying more for an app where I still can't see liked tracks inside my playlists and it auto-plays video clips while I browse? I'm switching back to Apple Music, I'm done with this.
Spotify raising prices while artists still get fractions of a cent per stream. Not a single word about artists in that announcement that I can see. I'm not a happy customer on this one.

Ha, premium price going up while the music tab is still a feed of cards? I already cancelled over this and I'm seriously looking at Apple Music now. Hi-fi would have been nice but I'm not holding my breath.
